secrets-2-store-organize-secrets.summary: Supports secret/key/certificate purpose, exact secret RBAC roles, metadata visibility, vault boundaries and soft-delete recovery. Excludes the unit’s broad HSM/key-export/key-type generalizations; no claim that all secrets use HSM protection.

secrets-3-retrieve-secrets-sdk.summary: Supports SecretClient value versus metadata reads, error categories, async client/credential lifetimes and reuse. Do not treat its abbreviated DefaultAzureCredential list as a complete version-independent chain. Linked Python API readme is captured separately but unapproved.

secrets-4-handle-versioning-rotation.summary: Supports creation of new versions, metadata inspection, disabling a specific version, informational expiry, rotation patterns and explicit consumer refresh. Excludes latest-enabled fallback and deletion of individual historical versions; no automatic secret rotation policy claim.

secrets-5-implement-caching-strategies.summary: Supports per-process TTL, startup preload, distributed-cache tradeoffs, monotonic elapsed-time measurement, event invalidation with TTL fallback and jittered retry. Use separately retrieved service limits for exact quotas; cache design bounds require successful refresh and stated concurrency.

config-2-connect-app-configuration.summary: Supports Python provider Mapping, JSON content type, literal keys, SettingSelector order, trimming, managed-identity data roles and explicit refresh calls gated by an interval. No quickstart ancestry inferred from the generic provider name.

config-3-organize-labels-feature-flags.summary: Supports key-label identity, null-label defaults, ordered composition and separately enabled feature-flag refresh plus FeatureManager evaluation. A sentinel is a publication signal, not a transaction or a wall-clock scheduler.

config-4-reference-key-vault-secrets.summary: Supports reference content type, actual client-side secret resolution, independently scoped data roles, keyvault_credential and secret_refresh_interval. Excludes HSM-for-all-secrets, automatic secret rotation-policy and unconditional refresh assertions.

config-5-decide-app-config-vs-key-vault.summary: Supports sensitivity-based placement and reference indirection only. Rejects the unit’s generalized HSM and expiry-enforcement claims; no unsupported lifecycle/security comparison is carried into questions.

otel-2-explore-opentelemetry-observabili.summary: Text tab establishes APIs, SDKs, instrumentation, exporters, trace/span/parent identity and W3C HTTP context. Supports semantic mappings without using video, assessments or release-status inference.

otel-3-add-opentelemetry-sdk.summary: Text tab supports Python Distro startup, explicit code connection precedence, service namespace/name and instance identity. Python version prerequisite is taken from the direct current product page; automatic logging and instrumentation are not generalized to every library.

otel-4-configure-spans-traces.summary: Text tab supports span kinds, resource-versus-span attributes, context-manager lifetime, handled exception recording and explicit error status. Generic nested-span latency question is withheld as an installed AI-103 duplicate.

otel-5-export-telemetry-azure-monitor.summary: Text tab supports export tables, Python sampling overrides, independent metric signal and bounded offline retry. Current product page supplies 1.8.6 default boundary. Multiple services appearing in Logs is not treated as proof of context propagation.

otel-6-debug-distributed-flows-trace-dat.summary: Text tab supports trace waterfall, emitter identity, operation_Id correlation and KQL customDimensions conversion. Joining on operation_Id establishes trace membership rather than immediate parentage or causal proof.

kql-2-write-basic-kql-queries.summary: Text tab supports Application Insights versus workspace table names, pipe/where/project/extend semantics, aggregates, distinct estimates and chart presentation. Binning-only question is excluded as an installed SC-200 duplicate.

kql-3-explore-logs-errors-performance.summary: Text tab supports itemCount-weighted estimates, explicit inner joins, column disambiguation and per-target latency aggregation. Correct the example’s mislabeled request-role/exception-emitter interpretation; never promise exact reconstruction from sampling.

doc-otel-enable.summary: Current direct product page supports Python 3.10+, Azure Monitor Distro initialization and destination setup. Release-status section delegates detailed maturity to a FAQ not directly linked by training; it does not assert every feature GA.

doc-otel-config.summary: Current product page supports Python resource identity, sampling types/units, 1.8.6 default, trace-based log filtering and storage override. Live Metrics carries an explicit Python Preview legal notice; no Java-only overrides, native ingestion or GenAI extensions are borrowed.

doc-otel-spans.summary: Read Python custom telemetry and exception sections: automatic escaping exceptions, manual record_exception, and language-specific customization. Community experimental instrumentations and GenAI feedback extensions are excluded.

doc-kql.summary: Current article grounds Azure Monitor KQL/log-query use and explicitly distinguishes supported scope from Azure Data Explorer-only constructs. Linked operator references are not silently admitted through a doc-to-doc chain.

doc-kv-limits.summary: Current vault-resource quotas: 4,000 other transactions and collective 300 CREATE secret/IMPORT certificate/IMPORT key per 10 seconds; subscription limit five times per vault. Backup bound 500 versions, no individual-version deletion, same-subscription/geography restoration. Managed HSM has separate limits.

excludedRetrievedSources.reason: Actual direct SDK-unit link, but absent from credential allowlist; HTML resolves with view=azure-python. Not used by candidates or registry.
